mapper.insert: INSERT INTO xxl_work_item ( batch_id, item_no, bucket_no, planned_failures, status, attempt_count, available_at, created_at, updated_at ) SELECT #{batchId}, item_no, MOD(item_no - 1, 64), -- NULLIF 把 failEvery=0 变成 NULL，避免依赖 SQL 表达式短路来防止除零。 CASE WHEN MOD(item_no, NULLIF(#{failEvery}, 0)) = 0 THEN #{failTimes} ELSE 0 END, 'PENDING', 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP FROM generate_series(1, #{itemCount}) AS item_no ON CONFLICT (batch_id, item_no) DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM xxl_work_item WHERE batch_id = #{batchId}

WITH candidates AS ( SELECT item.id FROM xxl_work_item item JOIN xxl_batch batch ON batch.id = item.batch_id WHERE batch.status IN ('READY', 'PROCESSING', 'RETRY_WAIT') AND ( (item.status IN ('PENDING', 'RETRY_WAIT') AND item.available_at <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) OR (item.status = 'RUNNING' AND item.lease_expires_at <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) ) AND (item.last_log_id IS NULL OR item.last_log_id <> #{logId}) AND item.attempt_count < #{maxAttempts} AND MOD(item.bucket_no, #{shardTotal}) = #{shardIndex} ORDER BY batch.id ASC, item.item_no ASC LIMIT #{batchSize} FOR UPDATE OF item SKIP LOCKED ) UPDATE xxl_work_item target SET status = 'RUNNING', attempt_count = target.attempt_count + 1, lease_token = CONCAT(#{leaseTokenPrefix}, '-', target.id), -- 领取条件和截止时间统一使用数据库时钟，避免不同 Executor 主机时钟漂移。 lease_expires_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP + (#{leaseSeconds} * INTERVAL '1 second'), last_log_id = #{logId}, last_error = NULL, completed_at = NULL, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP FROM candidates WHERE target.id = candidates.id RETURNING

WITH closed AS ( UPDATE xxl_work_item item SET status = 'DEAD', last_error = #{lastError}, lease_token = NULL, lease_expires_at = NULL, completed_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP FROM xxl_batch batch WHERE batch.id = item.batch_id AND batch.status IN ('READY', 'PROCESSING', 'RETRY_WAIT') AND item.status = 'RUNNING' AND item.lease_expires_at <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AND item.attempt_count >= #{maxAttempts} AND MOD(item.bucket_no, #{shardTotal}) = #{shardIndex} RETURNING item.batch_id ) SELECT DISTINCT batch_id FROM closed

WITH closed AS ( UPDATE xxl_work_item item SET status = 'DEAD', last_error = #{lastError}, lease_token = NULL, lease_expires_at = NULL, completed_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP FROM xxl_batch batch WHERE batch.id = item.batch_id AND batch.status IN ('READY', 'PROCESSING', 'RETRY_WAIT') AND item.status = 'RETRY_WAIT' AND item.attempt_count >= #{maxAttempts} AND MOD(item.bucket_no, #{shardTotal}) = #{shardIndex} RETURNING item.batch_id ) SELECT DISTINCT batch_id FROM closed
mapper.update: UPDATE xxl_work_item SET lease_expires_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP + (#{leaseSeconds} * INTERVAL '1 second'), updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'RUNNING' AND lease_token = #{leaseToken} AND lease_expires_at > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP

UPDATE xxl_work_item SET status = 'RETRY_WAIT', available_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP + (#{retryDelaySeconds} * INTERVAL '1 second'), last_error = #{lastError}, lease_token = NULL, lease_expires_at = NULL, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'RUNNING' AND lease_token = #{leaseToken}

UPDATE xxl_work_item SET status = 'DEAD', last_error = #{lastError}, lease_token = NULL, lease_expires_at = NULL, completed_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'RUNNING' AND lease_token = #{leaseToken}

UPDATE xxl_work_item SET status = 'SUCCESS', last_error = NULL, lease_token = NULL, lease_expires_at = NULL, completed_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'RUNNING' AND lease_token = #{leaseToken}

ORDER BY item.item_no ASC LIMIT #{pageSize} OFFSET #{offset}
